description: Abandon a stuck or unwanted active mission (marks it FAILED, no reward) and resets ship_status to IDLE if it was ON_MISSION. Frees a mission slot. Irreversible: progress is lost. Use this e.g. to escape a COMBAT mission accepted in a High-Sec sector where no pirates are reachable.

bearer.description: Your SPACE-CORE Bearer token. Only needed if your client cannot send the Authorization header.

name: abandon_mission
